subject: business-studies
title: PESTLE Foundations Adventure
welcome_lead: You'll meet PESTLE — political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental factors.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies external influences — the PESTLE framework explained.
final_note: You can list and define each PESTLE factor and give a real example of each.

concepts.def: Government policy and stability affecting business
New tech that creates or destroys markets
Laws on employment, consumers, the environment

walkthroughs.body_html:
PESTLE helps firms spot threats and opportunities outside their control.

If they ignore it, they may launch in a shrinking market or break new laws.
P: Brexit changing trade rules. E: rising interest rates. S: ageing population. T: AI tools. L: minimum wage rise. En: single-use plastic bans.
Firms react by adjusting strategy: cut costs in a recession, invest in tech to stay competitive, switch suppliers to meet new laws.

mcqs.q: An ageing population is which PESTLE factor?
A government raising the minimum wage is which factor?

numericals.q: Sales fall from £200,000 to £170,000 during a recession. What is the % fall, in %?
